prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” broker for everyone — the right one depends on whether you need individual/family, ACA marketplace, small‑group/employer, or Medicare coverage, which side of the city (KS vs MO), and your preferences (in‑person help, fee vs commission, number of carriers offered). I can help you find a great local broker — a couple quick questions first:

- Are you looking for individual/family, small‑business group, or Medicare (Part A/B/D/Advantage) help?
- Kansas City, MO or Kansas City, KS (or a ZIP code)?
- Do you prefer an independent broker who represents many carriers, or a captive agent tied to one company?

If you want to start vetting brokers now, here are practical tips and resources:

How to find and choose a good broker
- Use the state insurance department license lookup to confirm they’re licensed in MO and/or KS.
  - Missouri Dept. of Commerce & Insurance and Kansas Insurance Department both offer license verification.
- Use Healthcare.gov’s local agent/broker finder for ACA plans, or Medicare.gov/your local SHIP for Medicare assistance.
- Prefer independent brokers who represent multiple carriers — they can show more plan options.
- Check online reviews (Google, Yelp) and ask for local client references.
- Ask these questions when you interview a broker:
  - Which carriers and plan types do you work with locally?
  - Do you charge a fee or work on commission?
  - Can you show side‑by‑side comparisons (premiums, deductibles, OOP max, networks)?
  - How do you handle enrollment, renewals, and claims help after I pick a plan?
  - Do you have experience with people in my situation (doctors, meds, chronic conditions)?
- Red flags: refuses to show plan comparisons, gives only one option, avoids questions about commissions or post‑enrollment support.

If you want, I can:
- Look up 3–5 well‑rated independent brokers or agencies in your ZIP code and plan type, or
- Draft a short script/email you can use to contact brokers and compare answers.

Tell me your plan type and ZIP (or side of KC) and I’ll pull up local options.
